name: The Burning Mill
summary: Jonah Sawyer is trapped on a beam at the top of the burning windmill with his sister Liza, who is now a scarecrow.

stages.journal: Martha begged us to save Jonah from the windmill before it falls.
stages.hint: Climb the mill and get Jonah down before it collapses.

stages.journal: We got Jonah out. He was ashamed to say what he and Martha had quarrelled over.
The mill fell with Jonah on the beam.
